title: Figure 16: McDonnell roll-bonded titanium structure photo with insulation schematic
description: Composite figure: a black-and-white photograph of a corrugated titanium sandwich structure (embedded caption "Figure 6.1 McDonnell titanium structure. (Courtesy of John Robson)") beneath a schematic of a "metal shingle vacuum multi-layer insulation" layer with arrows for "Aero Heating" and "97.5% Radiated to Space," labeled "diffusion bonded super-plastically formed structure." Caption: "Figure 16. McDonnell Aircraft Company Roll-Bonded Titanium Structure (circa 1963). Today this structure would be super-plastically formed and diffusion bonded from RSR titanium sheets."
